chunks.text: Everyday Account Product Disclosure Statement (PDS): Overdraft fees apply only when you have an arranged overdraft facility and your balance goes below zero. Unarranged overdrafts may incur a higher dishonour fee.

Business Account PDS: Overdraft fees are charged per calendar day the account remains overdrawn beyond the fee-free buffer. A business overdraft facility must be approved before fees apply at the scheduled rate.
Corporate Account PDS: Overdraft fees apply to approved corporate overdraft limits. Treasury-linked accounts may have bespoke fee schedules in the facility agreement.
Student Account PDS: A reduced overdraft fee schedule applies while the account holder is enrolled full-time. Proof of enrolment is required to maintain the student rate.
Premier Account PDS: Premier customers receive five fee-free overdraft days per month. After that, standard premier overdraft daily fees apply.
